review.tagline: Agent skill that turns descriptions or repos into interactive HTML diagrams
review.summary: Archify is a skill for Cursor, Claude Code, Codex CLI and OpenCode, installed with `npx skills add tt-a1i/archify -g`. Given a description or a repository, the agent generates a self-contained interactive HTML diagram of one of five types: architecture, workflow, sequence, data flow or lifecycle. Output supports theme switching, route and reach tracing, and PNG or share-card export.
review.audience: Developers using AI coding agents who want shareable interactive diagrams
strengths: Output is standalone HTML that opens in a browser without installing Archify
Five diagram types, plus Before/Delta/After architecture comparison with a machine receipt
Works from a plain description; no repository required
Update check can be disabled with ARCHIFY_UPDATE_CHECK_DISABLED=1 and never auto-installs
weaknesses: Needs an AI coding agent and its model; Archify does not generate diagrams alone
Optional update check makes a network GET to a fixed manifest by default
Deployment-ownership profile checks authored facts only, not live infrastructure
README is heavy on sponsors and promotion, which buries technical details
needs: Needs Node.js (npx), Cursor, Claude Code, Codex CLI or OpenCode
Models: unknown (uses the host agent's model)
